description: Identified HEIDENHAIN LS 477 housing/readhead procurement kits, or separately ordered MSL 41 mounting spars. Inspection children remain included items, not additional orders.
releaseRequirements: Obtain an authentic factory quotation and delivered certificate for the selected ID, accuracy grade, interpolation, cable and reference-mark execution.
Order the matching MSL 41 separately; use the manufacturer mounting instructions and supplied clamping hardware, not nominal reconstructed contours.
Verify the actual TTL differential interface, pinout, shielding, supply current and fault behavior against the servo-drive CN5 manual before wiring.
Commission both motor and linear feedback, following-error limits, homing/reference capture and laser compensation over the full machine travel.
A scale accuracy grade is not finished-part tolerance or machine positioning certification.
